title: 方程式のオーサーシップ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the final day to make adjustments for the autumn Tenno Sho. Once we get through this, the battle with Narita Brian at the Arima Kinen awaits.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Biwa Hayahide tells me that she's going to get some rest and heads home, but I stay behind and continue to gather intel on Narita Brian.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The more I learn about her, the more anxious I get. My hard work is cutting into my sleep time, and I think I might be reaching my limits…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm taken by surprise when Biwa Hayahide returns and starts scolding me for working under such fatigue.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With tears in her eyes, she explains that success will be impossible if one of us is too exhausted to go on—we have to support each other. Humbled by her words, I agree to get more rest.
